For Korean joining with the hardcoded `", "` into "Cline {{items}}" results with
```
Cline이 파일 3개, 검색 2회 수행 읽음
```

Agent review noted this as a word salad. Chinese gets ASCII commas.
agent: fixed in 3d7457208 — every part is now a self-contained verb phrase (파일 3개를 읽음) and joining uses Intl.ListFormat per locale; summaryRead dropped, en output unchanged
